title: Older-home service repairs have repeated grounding and service-equipment failure clusters
business_problem: Repeat corrections on older-home service work create extra truck rolls and margin loss.
local_signal: Dallas residential permit and inspection histories for service repairs in older South Dallas and Oak Cliff housing stock.
evidence_we_expect: Failed inspection notes repeatedly mention grounding, mast, meter-socket, or service-equipment issues on similar job types.
why_generic_models_miss_it: The pattern depends on local housing stock, Dallas inspection language, and the contractor's actual callback history.
value_if_true: The company can build an older-home readiness checklist that prevents avoidable first-pass failures.
test_plan: Group failed-to-passed sequences by ZIP code and job type, then compare repeated failure labels and recommended-next-action outcomes.

title: Reviewed correction paths can be normalized into a reusable older-home reinspection playbook
business_problem: Crews rely on memory to interpret terse failed inspection notes, which creates inconsistent corrections.
local_signal: Failed inspection notes, callback texts, and reinspection outcomes for residential service and rewire jobs.
evidence_we_expect: The same few correction steps recur before successful reinspections on comparable jobs.
why_generic_models_miss_it: The best next action depends on local inspector phrasing and what this business actually changes before passing.
value_if_true: A ranked next-action recommender could shorten callback loops and reduce office coordination time.
test_plan: Create reviewed label rows that map failed notes to the correction steps that preceded a pass, then score recommended-next-action quality.

title: Neighborhood slices can predict which older-home jobs need deeper pre-inspection prep
business_problem: Some neighborhoods generate recurring surprises that were not captured at estimate time.
local_signal: Permit addresses, ZIP codes, property age proxies, and inspection results for residential electrical jobs.
evidence_we_expect: A subset of ZIP codes shows concentrated correction patterns tied to detached garages, older panels, or service-mast work.
why_generic_models_miss_it: These are locality-specific housing patterns, not general electrical guidance.
value_if_true: Estimating and inspection readiness can be tailored by neighborhood before material or crew time is committed.
test_plan: Run pattern extraction over grouped permit and inspection slices by ZIP code, permit subtype, and outcome path.
